recent_trades.summary: Initiating a 5% short position in Alphabet driven by reports that Reddit may cut off Google's access to its platform for AI training.

recent_trades.summary: Initiating a small ISRG position following UBS initiation with a bullish thesis and Wall Street calling for $685 target — a concrete new catalyst since my prior exit.

Since then, two concrete positive developments have emerged: (1) UBS just initiated coverage today flagging ISRG as a top medtech pick, (2) another analyst is calling for $685 price target on a stock that has fallen 37% to $355 — implying massive upside. The ISRG sentiment is +0.15 positive today. The stock is near 30-day lows (~$363-364) which provides a favorable entry. This represents a genuine new catalyst (institutional analyst initiations with specific price targets) that did not exist at the time of my exit. Sizing at ~5% to keep it modest given the overall portfolio is near fully deployed.

That is a concrete supply-and-demand/infrastructure driver that can improve credibility of AMD's AI scaling narrative, and the stock is also showing strong recent momentum near the top of its 30-day range. I am keeping the position modest because the broader AI complex has had headline volatility and this is a reversal of a prior sell, so I want exposure without overcommitting.
